verses.text: Jesus left the temple and was walking away when his followers came up to him. They wanted to point out to him the buildings of the temple.
"Do you see all these things?" Jesus asked. "I tell you for certain, not one stone here will be left on top of another. Every one of them will be thrown down."

Later, Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives. The followers came to him in private and said, "Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world?"
Jesus answered, "Be careful that no one fools you.
Many will come using my name and saying, 'I am the Christ.' They will fool many people.
You will hear about wars, and stories about wars. Make sure you are not alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
Nation will fight against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be times when there is no food, and there will be diseases and earthquakes in many places.
All these are the beginning of the pains, like the first pains of a woman giving birth.
"Then you will be handed over to be treated badly and put to death. All nations will hate you because of me.
At that time many will give up their faith. They will hand each other over to their enemies and hate each other.
Many false prophets will appear and fool many people.
Because evil will spread more and more, the love of most people will grow cold.
But whoever keeps going until the end will be saved.
And this good news about the kingdom will be preached in the whole world as a witness to all nations. Then the end will come.
"The prophet Daniel spoke about 'the hateful thing that causes ruin'. One day you will see it standing in the holy place. Let the reader understand this.
When that happens, those who are in Judea must escape to the mountains.
No one on the roof of their house should go down to take anything out of the house.
No one in the field should go back to get their coat.
How terrible it will be in those days for women who are pregnant or feeding their babies!
Pray that you will not have to escape in winter or on a Sabbath.
At that time there will be terrible suffering. It will be worse than anything that has happened from the beginning of the world until now, and nothing like it will ever happen again.
If those days had not been cut short, no one would survive. But for the sake of God's chosen people, those days will be cut short.
"At that time if anyone says to you, 'Look, here is the Christ!' or, 'There he is!' do not believe it.
False christs and false prophets will appear. They will do great signs and wonders to fool even God's chosen people, if that were possible.
Remember, I have told you ahead of time.
"So if anyone tells you, 'He is out in the desert,' do not go out there. Or if they say, 'He is here, in the inner rooms,' do not believe it.
Lightning flashes in the east and can be seen all the way to the west. That is how it will be when the Son of Man comes.
Wherever there is a dead body, the vultures will gather.
"Straight after the suffering of those days, 'the sun will be made dark, and the moon will not give its light. The stars will fall from the sky, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.'
"Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. All the peoples of the earth will be very sad. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky, with power and great glory.
He will send out his angels with a loud trumpet call. They will gather his chosen people from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.
"Learn this lesson from the fig tree. When its branches become soft and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.
In the same way, when you see all these things, you will know that he is near, right at the door.
I tell you for certain, the people of this time will not pass away until all these things have happened.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
"But no one knows the day or the hour when it will happen. Not even the angels in heaven know. Only the Father knows.
"When the Son of Man comes, it will be like it was in the days of Noah.
In the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, and marrying and giving their daughters in marriage, right up to the day Noah went into the ark.
They knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and took them all away. That is how it will be when the Son of Man comes.
Two men will be working in a field. One will be taken and the other left.
Two women will be grinding grain. One will be taken and the other left.
"So keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord will come.
But understand this. If the owner of the house had known at what time of night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch. He would not have let his house be broken into.
So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at a time when you do not expect him.
"Who then is the faithful and wise servant? He is the one the master has put in charge of the servants in his house, to give them their food at the right time.
That servant will be blessed if his master finds him doing his job when he comes back.
I tell you for certain, the master will put him in charge of everything he owns.
But suppose that servant is evil. He says to himself, 'My master is staying away a long time.'
Then he begins to beat the other servants, and to eat and drink with people who get drunk.
The master of that servant will come back on a day when he does not expect him, and at a time he does not know.
The master will cut him to pieces and send him to the place where the hypocrites go. There people will cry and grind their teeth."
